discovery.boundary: Retaining a read directory handle does not prevent creating a new child. Windows directory metadata may not change during immediate creation; the old vocabulary function would then switch from verified shared BPE to a new local BPE.

function_probe.method: Independent offline Rust program copies exact pinned hotwords.rs, creates fictional model/shared/audio directories and minimal fictional BPE data, holds a Windows directory handle with FILE_SHARE_READ and the same open flags, calls actual vocabulary function before and after creating model/bpe.model.
function_probe.preparation_note: First Cargo invocation stopped before compiling because its temporary crate was nested under another workspace. An independent workspace declaration was added and the probe then passed.

limits: Separate synthetic directory trials on one machine; counts are not a cross-system failure rate.
The isolated program exercises the exact hotwords vocabulary function and equivalent native directory-open flags, not the complete product receipt or worker lifecycle.
It establishes local child creation and vocabulary selection drift but does not show a real worker loading a tampered user model or any actual exploitation.
No user model, microphone, recording, GPU, or network data was used.

checks: Existing writer was opened before admission; verification failed closed, then succeeded after writer release.
After successful admission, opening another writer was denied until both cache and receipt owners released handles.
For two model assets, clearing cache and dropping the original receipt did not release protections held by two clones; dropping one clone still blocked modification.
Immediately after the final clone was released, same-length corruption of a secondary asset succeeded, and a fresh SHA-based admission rejected it.
After clearing the cache and releasing the only receipt, an immediate same-length primary asset modification was rejected by fresh admission.

limits: The first run is the unmodified fixed-source model_integrity unit test subset, not the entire Windows CI job.
The second run appends test-only functions in a separate local worktree; production logic was not modified or committed.
Synthetic temporary files only; no user model, audio or private contents were accessed.
No GPU component, SDK, installer, real model loading, external mmap/native reopen path, or release acceptance was tested.
Windows-only observations do not establish Linux or macOS behavior.

change.shared_argument: Authoritative when Some; exact nonempty bounded token inventories must match. A later primary/bpe.model cannot override it.

read_bounds.rule: Read at most limit+1 then reject overflow before parsing or rewriting export.
